titles.title: Protecting Taxpayers from Ghost Preparers Act
Protecting Taxpayers from Ghost Preparers Act
To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to apply tax return preparation penalties to improperly altered returns, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Ordered to be Reported in the Nature of a Substitute by the Yeas and Nays: 40 - 0.
